questionText:

At the news desk of a major news wire agency, sub-editors and correspondents faced an onslaught of fragmented, chaotic reports. To communicate the catastrophe with speed, accuracy, and clarity, the agency deployed the classic 'Inverted Pyramid' news structure. The urgent opening lead paragraph answered the essential 5 Ws and 1 H: Who (thousands of coastal residents), What (killed by massive tsunami waves), Where (across South and Southeast Asian coasts), When (Sunday morning following a massive earthquake), and Why/How (triggered by an undersea tectonic rupture). questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Prime-time news debates in India typically assemble 6 to 10 panelists on a multi-split screen under an assertive celebrity anchor.
Statement II: Prime-time debate shows are cheaper to produce than investigative field documentary journalism.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid NCERT facts erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is true while Statement II contains an error.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Both statements are true. Studio shouting debates are far less expensive than sustained investigative field journalism, driving their ubiquity.
Hence Option C is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
